observation.visible_scene: A rear view of a vehicle/trailer bumper in a workshop/garage with a concrete floor. The bumper carries a backlit 'LED4x4' plate, two round speed-limit stickers (70 and 80), red-and-orange diagonal reflective stripes, two main tail-light clusters at the lower corners, two small round side-marker lamps on protruding arms, and two dark square recessed lamps. A coiled white cable and a yellow container are visible at the right edge.
visible_changes: In the first five frames (t=0 to ~0.27 s) all lamps are unlit: the tail-light clusters, the side markers, and the plate area are dark.

Between frame 5 and frame 6 (~t=0.34 s) the lamps switch on: the two main tail lights illuminate red with a bright white/amber inward-pointing arrow/chevron pattern, the small side-marker lamps glow red, and the 'LED4x4' plate becomes backlit.
From frame 6 to the last frame (t=0.34 s to 2.70 s) the lights remain steadily on with no visible sequential animation or change in pattern; the illuminated arrow shapes look the same in every frame.
The vehicle itself stays in place throughout; only the lighting state changes.

There is a slight change in framing between the start and end of the clip (the bumper occupies marginally more width at the end), suggesting a small camera drift/zoom, but the background objects do not move relative to the vehicle.
outside_clip_unknowns: What triggered the lights to turn on (switch, brake pedal, remote) is not shown.
Whether the lights later turn off or change mode is outside the excerpt.
The full identity/type of the vehicle and the rest of the workshop are not visible.
uncertain_details: The exact function of the lit pattern (position vs brake vs indicator) cannot be determined from the stills.
The small apparent size/framing shift could be camera motion or compression artifact; magnitude is minor.
Subtle brightness flicker in the LEDs across frames is not clearly resolvable.
